description: This file implements a network packet socket sample for Zephyr OS, involving socket creation, packet sending and receiving, and interface management.

methods.name: recv_packet
methods.description: Receives network packets in a separate thread, creating and configuring sockets.

methods.name: send_packet
methods.description: Sends dummy network packets in a separate thread, creating and configuring sockets.

methods.name: start_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket for packet transmission.

methods.name: recv_packet_socket
methods.description: Receives packets from a socket with timeout handling.

methods.name: send_packet_socket
methods.description: Sends dummy data packets through a socket.

methods.name: wait_for_interface
methods.description: Waits until the network interface is up before starting packet operations.
